chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Abi 'Abdillah al-Razi, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abi 'Abdillah al-Mu'min, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I said to Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: Is zina worse, or drinking wine? And how is it that for wine there are eighty, while for zina there are one hundred?
So he said: "O Ishaq, the hadd is one, but more was added in this case because of his wasting the drop and placing it in other than its place which Allah has commanded for it."

key_terms.ثَمَانُونَ: eighty lashes, mentioned here for wine drinking
key_terms.مِائَةٌ: one hundred lashes, mentioned here for zina

ai.seo_question: Why is the hadd punishment for zina greater than the hadd for drinking wine in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning the difference between the hadd punishment for drinking wine and for zina. The Imam عليه السلام explains that the increase in the punishment for zina is due to the wasting of the reproductive drop and placing it outside the lawful location ordained by Allah.
